text: The 2020–2025 NZ Flood Risk Reduction and Mitigation Initiatives encompass a suite of strategic and practical measures aimed at reducing flood risk in New Zealand. These initiatives include a national strategic framework, legislative streamlining, and local project implementation, notably the Wairoa Flood Mitigation Project. The initiatives focus on integrating national policy, legislative facilitation, and community-led local projects to address riverine flooding risks exacerbated by climate change.
